999008199.text: ゴホンっ、んっ……んんっ……ん！
では、参ります……
星の神に畏み畏み申す――

localizations.en: With great reverence, I beseech the gods of the stars—

999008199.text:
うむ……やはり儀式の時の千歳は美しい。
普段は可憐という表現が似合っているが

localizations.en: Mm... Chitose really is beautiful during ceremonies. Not that she isn't lovely normally, but this is different.

999008199.text: はい、厳かというか、浮世離れしているような……

localizations.en: Yes, she seems so solemn and otherworldly...

999008199.text:
……初めて城へ来た頃と比べ、
長い祝詞も淀みなく言えるようになった……成長したな

localizations.en: Compared to when she first came to the castle, she can now recite even lengthy prayers without faltering... Oh how you've grown.

999008199.text:
とても素敵だと思います。……恥ずかしながら、
あまり意味は分かっていないのですが

localizations.en: It is a wonderful sight. ...Though I'm embarrassed to say I don't fully understand what she's saying.

999008199.text:
古い言葉だから、ケイウンの民でもあまり
分からないんじゃないかな。もちろん俺は分かるけど

localizations.en: They're ancient sayings, so most people in Keiun don't really understand them as well. However it goes without saying that I do, of course.

999008199.text:
新しいもの好きの鏑矢も、初めは悪戦苦闘してたが
千歳のために一生懸命勉強していたからね

localizations.en: Even Kaburaya, who easily grasps new concepts, struggled with them at first. But she studied hard for Chitose's sake.

999008199.text:
古き文化からも学べることはある。
千歳のためを思えば、なおさら身も入るというものだ

localizations.en: There is wisdom in the words of the past. And thinking of Chitose motivates me all the more.

999008199.text:
千歳のことになるとお前はいつもそうだね。
ま、今は儀式に集中しようか

localizations.en: You're always like this when it comes to her. Oh well, let's just enjoy the ceremony that's in front of us.

999008199.text:
まさか物の怪とは思わなかったけど……
コウセン、お前の陰陽術は本物だったぜ

localizations.en: I never imagined he was a demon, but... Kosen, your onmyodo arts were the real deal.

999008199.text:
余への復讐のために磨き、培った技……
敵ながら大したものだったぞ

localizations.en: Skills honed and cultivated for the sole purpose of seeking revenge against me... even as your opponent, they were quite impressive to behold.

999008199.text:
（悪いことをしたし、許されないこともしたと思う。
　でも、今はただ……安らかに……）

localizations.en: (He did terrible things that can never be forgiven. Even so... I hope he can finally find peace...)

999008199.text:
……分からないな。
なぜあのような者に祈りを捧げる必要があるのか

localizations.en: ...This makes no sense. Why offer prayer to someone who caused such turmoil?

999008199.text:
「祟り」ってやつを恐れているのさ。
魂を鎮め、安らかに眠れるように祈るんだ

localizations.en: They fear some so-called curse. They pray to calm the soul so it can rest peacefully.

999008199.text:
祟りが本当にあるのであれば、
我らは大変なことになっていますな

localizations.en: If curses were real, we would be in serious trouble.

999008199.text: そうだなぁ。気にしていたら、やっていられないさ

localizations.en: True enough. That would really put a damper on our work.

999008199.text:
……とはいえなぁ、こういう割り切り方は
粋とはほど遠いんだよなぁ

localizations.en: ...Then again, shrugging off this spiritual stuff isn't exactly chic.

999008199.text: 参っちまうね

localizations.en: Things like that get to you after a while.

999008199.text:
同じようにして生まれたはずなのに……
姉上、あなたは昔とは随分変わられた

localizations.en: We were supposedly created the same way, yet... you've changed considerably from how you used to be.

999008199.text:
……そりゃあ、変わるよ。長く生きてりゃね。
なんたって、兄弟の中じゃ一番最初に目覚めたんだ

localizations.en: ...Well yeah, you change. Live long enough and you will. I was the first of us to wake up, after all.

999008199.text: お前さんだって、少しずつ変わっているはずさ、ゴゥ

localizations.en: You may not have noticed, but you're changing bit by bit too, Gou.
